text:
hi here :) also have done this process with turkish documents. firstly yes: documents need to be translated in hebrew and i can recommend de kalo lawyers in israel they are really good and they speak turkish and they translate everything in hebrew: https://de-kalo.co.il/en

you can get the documents with apostille electronic via: https://www.eapostil.gov.tr
just a quick reminder: you need to have a bank card from a turkish bank in order to be able to process with the payment. they dont accept international credit cards or other international paying method. 

i hope this helps!
